text:
ana_marketing: Heads-up: landing page is live on staging. Need final X + LinkedIn copy, two headline variants for A/B, and the 30s retarget clip by 3pm so we can queue.

 drew: dropping two headline options now. also confirm we have speaker blurbs and a clean 1200x628 thumbnail.

 kai: Timing suggestion: X primary 9:00am PT, X amplify 12:30pm PT, LinkedIn 11:00am PT. Past launches: demo signups peaked around 11-12.

 sam-prod: Can someone upload the enterprise seedlist? I'll wire HubSpot owner routing after that.

 ana_marketing: seed list uploaded: /Marketing/Events/Q2/webinar_enterprise_seedlist.csv. Use utm_source=x_social and utm_campaign=inference_launch_apr. Use column "owner_email" for AE routing.

 drew: Copy A (X short): "Webinar 5/14: How production teams make LLM inference reliable + cheap. Demo + benchmarks + live Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

 drew: Copy B (LinkedIn long): "Production inference is hard. Join Redwood on 5/14 for benchmark-driven plays, a live demo, and actionable steps to cut per-token cost without sacrificing latency. Panel + Q&A. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar"

 kai: Headline variants for A/B test: 1) "Reduce LLM cost without losing latency" 2) "Benchmark-backed playbooks for inference at scale". Run test only on 12:30pm X slot.

 ana_marketing: CTA options: [Register - Save My Seat], [Get Benchmarks - Download Snapshot]. For paid creative, primary CTA should be Register.

 drew: Thread plan for X (4 tweets): 1) stat tease w/ image, 2) problem statement, 3) quick bulleted takeaway, 4) CTA + pinned link in replies. We'll attach the benchmark stat image to tweet 1.

 kai: Small experiment: run same thread twice with image vs plain text first tweet (to test impressions lift). Tag experiments in scheduler.

 design-bot: assets: thumbnail_1200x628_v3.png uploaded to /Marketing/Events/Q2/assets. speaker_bios_v2.docx uploaded. clip_30s_v1.mp4 in progress.

 ana_marketing: Can design deliver the 30s cut by 2:45pm? We need it for paid creative.

 drew: pinging @design for clip confirm.

 design-bot: clip_30s_v1.mp4 ETA 14:30 PT. Will export two encodes (web, mobile).

 sam-prod: Routing rules drafted: 
- If owner_email matches active AE -> assign to AE in HubSpot.
- If owner_email blank or AE offline -> assign to SDR queue with tag "inference_webinar_apr".
- If domain in enterprise allowlist -> set priority=high and notify AE via Slack.
- Add webhook: if no AE claim in 30 minutes -> post to #sales-triage with lead link and templated outreach.

 ana_marketing: Add fallback outreach template: "Hi {first_name}, thanks for registering for our webinarwe'd love to share the benchmark snapshot and offer a quick 15-min intro demo. Are mornings or afternoons better?"

 kai: QA: benchmark snapshot gated behind email capture. Make sure GA event "benchmark_snapshot_download" fires and we mark conversion in HubSpot.

 ana_marketing: Confirmed the gating flow, product added GA event. Please verify in staging before launch.

 ops-bot: scheduled post: platform=X time=2024-05-14T09:00:00-07:00 id=post_9052 status=queued :white_check_mark:

 drew: I'll set the A/B headline test in the scheduler for the 12:30pm slot (headline A vs headline B; same creative otherwise).

 ana_marketing: Sophie from growth suggested we also test an emoji-led headline variant vs plain text for social only. Let's keep that for the amplify slot.

 sam-prod: After registrant ingestion, we'll enrich leads with company size and mark enterprise flag if employee_count > 1000. That will also route to AE.

 kai: Note for analytics: pull the first-hour engagement numbers, conversions, and demo signup rate and compare to April baseline. Target: CTR >= +8% vs baseline.

 drew: Also want to test pinned reply with download link vs link in main tweet to measure click-through difference. We'll run pinned reply as default.

 ana_marketing: Great. Once live, I'll pull the hour-1 snapshot and post in #marketing-ops. If engagement lags, we'll boost the 12:30pm slot with small paid spend focusing on the enterprise seed.

 design-bot: uploaded alt thumbnails for A/B creative: thumb_altA.png and thumb_altB.png.

 drew: Everything looks good. I'll push final copy into scheduler by 5pm and upload the A/B mapping CSV.

 ana_marketing: Thanks team. If anything blocks, ping here.
